argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge-R70-GPT-PLANNER-20261014-GPT6'
$sha='042a519f91446c5e96fd165c6e224f78e196b41d'
if(([string](& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)).Trim() -ne $sha){throw 'R70_SOURCE_SHA_CHANGED'}
$plan=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-plan.json'
$state=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-state.json'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state){throw 'R70_STATE_EXISTS_RECONCILE_FIRST'}
$log=& node.exe (Join-Path $root 'app\r70-stage-gpt-planner.js') --stage $plan $state 2>&1
$rc=$LASTEXITCODE
if($rc -ne 0){Write-Output ('STAGE_EXIT='+$rc);Write-Output ('SAFE_STAGE_REASON='+[string]($log|Out-String).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(240,([string]($log|Out-String)).Length)));throw 'R70_STAGING_REFUSED'}
$j=($log|Out-String)|ConvertFrom-Json
$p=Get-Content -LiteralPath $plan -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output ('STAGE_STATUS='+$j.status)
Write-Output ('PLAN_ID='+$p.id)
Write-Output ('PLAN_DISPATCH_ALLOWED='+$p.allowDispatch)
Write-Output ('PLAN_MAX_PARALLEL='+$p.maxParallel)
Write-Output ('PLANNER_PROVIDER='+$p.brain.provider)
Write-Output ('PLANNER_AUTO_ACCEPT='+$p.brain.autoAccept)
Write-Output ('PLAN_GITHUB_REPOSITORY='+$p.agents[0].repository)
Write-Output ('PLAN_BRANCH='+$p.agents[0].branch)
Write-Output ('START_SHA='+$p.tasks[0].expectedHead)
Write-Output ('TARGET_CHAT_BOUND='+[bool]$p.agents[0].chatId)
Write-Output ('PLAN_LOCAL_EXISTS='+[bool](Test-Path $plan))
Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
if($p.allowDispatch -ne $false){throw 'UNSAFE_PLAN_SHOULD_NEVER_DISPATCH'}
data.stdout:

START_SHA=439813afe941d4d7d6025d24bb65cfc4a1c402ab
TARGET_CHAT_BOUND=True
